WITH att AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00'), pt AS (SELECT market_ticker, pnl, created_at, closed_at FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00'), orphan AS (SELECT * FROM pt WHERE market_ticker NOT IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM att))
SELECT '1_orphan_rows' k, count(*)::text||' rows, pnl='||to_char(COALESCE(sum(pnl),0),'FM990.0000') v FROM orphan
UNION ALL SELECT '2_orphan_has_ANY_live_order', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT o.market_ticker FROM live_orders o JOIN orphan ON orphan.market_ticker=o.market_ticker WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10') z
UNION ALL SELECT '3_orphan_order_by_OTHER_strategy', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT o.strategy FROM live_orders o JOIN orphan ON orphan.market_ticker=o.market_ticker) z
UNION ALL SELECT '4_orphan_opened_before_epoch', count(*)::text FROM orphan WHERE created_at < timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00'
UNION ALL SELECT '5_orphan_sample_'||row_number() over (order by created_at)::text, market_ticker||' opened='||to_char(created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI')||' pnl='||to_char(pnl,'FM990.0000') FROM orphan ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 12
